meta.description: Elf ultra-quiet curtain motor (Wi-Fi): connects directly to Mi Home, Tmall Genie and HomeAI, a Quiet noise-reduction chip down to 30 dB, a telescopic track installed in 5 minutes and a 10-year warranty.
motor_banner.banner_desc: Connects directly to 3 systems, truly quiet with its Quiet chip
sec2.motor_title: Connects directly to Mi Home, Tmall Genie and HomeAI
sec2.motor_desc: Works with the major smart speakers and voice platforms, so a single sentence opens or closes the curtains.
sec3.motor_title:
Quiet noise-reduction chip,
down to 30 dB
sec3.motor_desc: A dual-core MCU noise-reduction chip, combined with quiet helical gears, brings the running noise down to 30 dB, so you enjoy a smart home in peace.
sec4.title:
Made to look good at home,
not like an industrial part
sec4.motor_desc: Instead of the generic, industrial-looking housings common in the industry, it has a rounded one-piece design with a sandblasted, anodized finish that feels refined, for people who care how their home looks.
sec5.motor_title: Telescopic track: installed in 5 minutes, in one visit
sec5.motor_desc: No second visit, no aligning track sections, no connector strips, no locking the runners. In one visit, pull it out, lock it, and it's installed.
sec7.motor_title: Reinforced belt, true to shape for 20 years
sec7.motor_desc: Made of polyurethane, it is supple, resists stretching and keeps its shape for 20 years. Seven galvanized steel wires inside make it twice as tough as an ordinary belt.
sec8.motor_desc: Wear-resistant stainless steel bearings handle up to 100,000 turns and last 30 years*.
sec8.desc: *100,000 turns measured in ORVIBO's lab; 30 years assumes the motor runs 8 to 10 times a day.
sec9.motor_title: Zinc alloy star-shaped shaft: steady, without slipping
sec9.motor_desc: Six teeth grip the gearbox, so it never slips or rattles. Made of zinc alloy, far stronger than plastic, it lasts 20 years without replacement.
sec10.motor_desc: A 10-year warranty, far beyond the industry norm, so you can use it with peace of mind.
sec11.motor_title: Opening set by the percent, steplessly
sec11.motor_desc: Forget the old button remote: with an intuitive slider on MixPad, you set exactly how far the curtains open each time, so you decide how bright the room is.
sec12.motor_title: With a MixPad smart switch, scenes for the whole home
sec12.motor_desc: Unlike a smart speaker, the MixPad smart switch links the curtains with the whole home: no wake word, a single sentence opens or closes them.
sec12.slide_title: The moment the door opens, the lights and curtains open to welcome you home.
sec12.slide_title2: Say “Butler, I want to watch a movie”: the curtains close and the lights switch to movie mode.
sec12.slide_title3: Lights off, curtains closed, air conditioning set: ready for bed in one step.
meta.spec.description: Elf Ultra-quiet Curtain Motor specifications: model C20WZ, 100–240 V AC, 36 W, 1.2 N·m of torque, 40 kg load, 35 dB, IP40.
spec.name: Product: Elf Ultra-quiet Curtain Motor
